limitations: No actual PumpPortal/raw feed field verification, discovery coverage or measured provider arrival rates.
No socket/network, RPC/pool pricing, ledger writes, trading/exits, publication or financial reconciliation in this benchmark.
Synthetic record availability times are preserved; accelerating replay does not establish 72 seconds, 24 hours or 72 hours of unattended operation.
Rates apply only to this short selected normalized payload and 12-candidate workload on this execution workspace; not a universal capacity or EC2 bound.
Finite offline backlog is drained; no production queue or sustained-memory/long-outage behavior is proved.
Recorder write/flush and initial record loading are outside timed replay; per-row JSON parsing, feature checks, rule refusals, metrics and cooperative yields are inside.
Runs share one process, OS scheduling and JIT/GC state; memory is sampled and rate results are sensitive to short-run overhead.
Every strategy decision refuses unverified feed fields; no qualified opportunity, fill or economic edge is established.

The 72-second synthetic interval does not exercise 120-second identity pruning. Logical usage() counts exclude stale deque prefixes and historical objects retained by dedup identities; they are not a physical memory bound.
postRunAnnotation: Only logical-state interpretation labels and the corresponding script hash were updated after timing; measured rates, delays and counts are unchanged.
